mapper.sql: LEAST(d.duration_sec, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(d.last_seen_at + INTERVAL '1 second', #{to}) - GREATEST(d.started_at, #{from}))::int)
mapper.select: SELECT reason_code AS "reasonCode", category AS "category", reason_name AS "reasonName" FROM downtime_reason ORDER BY display_order

SELECT k.kind AS "kind", k.reason_code AS "reasonCode", r.reason_name AS "reasonName", r.category AS "category", r.display_order AS "displayOrder", sum(k.sec) AS "seconds", count(*) AS "count" FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN d.reason_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'REASON' WHEN d.duration_sec >= #{minSec} THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'MICRO' END AS kind, d.reason_code, AS sec
) k LEFT JOIN downtime_reason r ON r.reason_code = k.reason_code GROUP BY k.kind, k.reason_code, r.reason_name, r.category, r.display_order
mapper.sql: SELECT d.id AS "id", d.equipment_id AS "equipmentId", e.equipment_name AS "equipmentName", d.work_order_id AS "workOrderId", d.started_at AS "startedAt", d.last_seen_at AS "lastSeenAt", d.duration_sec AS "durationSec", d.last_seen_at >= now() - INTERVAL '10 seconds' AS "ongoing", d.alarm_code AS "alarmCode", a.alarm_name AS "alarmName", d.reason_code AS "reasonCode", r.reason_name AS "reasonName", r.category AS "category", d.reason_source AS "reasonSource", d.reason_by AS "reasonBy", d.reason_at AS "reasonAt"
JOIN equipment e ON e.equipment_id = d.equipment_id LEFT JOIN equipment_alarm a ON a.alarm_code = d.alarm_code LEFT JOIN downtime_reason r ON r.reason_code = d.reason_code
mapper.select:
FROM downtime d
WHERE d.last_seen_at > #{from} - INTERVAL '1 second' AND d.started_at < #{to} AND (d.duration_sec >= #{minSec} OR d.last_seen_at >= now() - INTERVAL '10 seconds') AND d.reason_code IS NULL ORDER BY (d.last_seen_at >= now() - INTERVAL '10 seconds') DESC, d.started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
